question: Which of the following shortcut key displays the Editor task pane to check spelling and grammar in the document or the selected text in MS-Word 365?
solution:
The correct answer is __**F7.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **MS-Word 365**, the shortcut key to display the **Editor task pane and check spelling and grammar** in the document or selected text is **F7**.
 
• It provides a** fast way to open the Editor task pane for spell and grammar checking** in MS-Word 365.
 
• The Editor task pane **examines spelling, grammar, style, and more, **offering suggestions for improvements.
 
• We can also customize settings in the Editor task pane to ignore specific errors or modify language preferences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **F10**

 
 
• Pressing F10 activates the **"KeyTips" **feature.
 
• KeyTips are **keyboard shortcuts that allow you to navigate and access various commands and options** in the Ribbon interface.
 
• Pressing F10 **displays KeyTips** on the Ribbon, enabling you to use the keyboard to access different tabs, commands, and options.
 
 
 
• **F1**
 
 
• Pressing F1 in Microsoft Word opens the **Help pane.**
 
• It provides access to the **Word Help feature**, where you can** find assistance, tutorials, and information **on using different features and functions within the application.
 
• We can** search for specific topics or browse **through the available help resources.
 
 
 
• **F2**
 
 
• Pressing F2 allows you to** edit the selected text directly.**
 
• It activates the **editing mode and places the cursor at the location of the selected text,** enabling you to make changes or modifications easily.
 
• This can be helpful for **quickly editing or updating content **within your document.
